scoring_justification: Checker recomputes expected values from the same analytic formulas and hidden parameters, then compares agent's reported numbers within tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference parameters used to compute expected drag coefficients, channel velocities, and active free velocity.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from the physical model parameters (K, gamma1, alpha4, r_core, r_max, d, zeta) as defined in the paper's minimal model.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded as typical values; the expected outputs are computed directly from the analytic formulas in the paper (Eqs. 33, 35, 46, 49, 64, 69).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These parameters are consistent with the paper's model and produce realistic values; they are not random.

outputs.description: The translational drag coefficients D1 (for +1/2 defect) and D1′ (for −1/2 defect) computed from the minimal model. Numeric values; units are consistent with the input parameters (K, γ1, α4, r_core, r_max).

CSV table of defect velocities in a planar channel for different values of the isotropic flow viscosity α4. Columns are alpha4 (float), u_plus_half (velocity of +1/2 defect), u_minus_half (velocity of −1/2 defect).
The steady-state free-propulsion velocity of an active +1/2 defect, computed from the analytic model. Numeric value; units consistent with inputs.

output_contract.notes: All three scored artifacts are obtained by evaluating explicit analytic formulas from the minimal model. The checker will independently recompute the expected values using the same formulas and parameters from /app/inputs/parameters.json, and compare with the agent's submitted numbers within appropriate numeric tolerances. The load-bearing requirement is not strictly enforced because there are no mandatory process steps; the agent must implement the formulas correctly to pass.
